component.name: KetraCopy
component.summary: Verified file copy/move with pause, resume and speed limits

description.p: KetraCopy copies and moves files with byte-level verification (inline or full SHA-256), pause/resume journals, speed limits, conflict policies, include/exclude filters and SHA-256 manifests for later re-verification.
The package ships the ketra command line tool (ketra) and the KetraCopy desktop application (ketra-gui).
